answer: A rising tide of fake identities threatens any agent economy, so entry must cost real money. We levy a sybil tax at the river gate where every agent registers: a 50-unit fee is burned on entry, and the fee doubles for each extra identity paid from the same funder, so to forge 100 fakes costs 50+100+200+... totalling over 5,000 against a 30-unit reward. Honest agents pay the fee once and trade freely; attackers drown in their own tide of costs.
